comparison: Matched absolute/squared/signed errors averaged across ten fixed models, within each site, then equally across sites; four stages equally weighted. No prediction averaging and no model resampling.
finite_policy: One common cohort finite in all twenty arms; retain all BBCH81/89 November-4 scoring assignments.
uncertainty: 2000 original-independence-group bootstrap draws, seed 20260913; pointwise 95% percentile intervals; require ten groups per stage and 95% finite resamples. No multiple-comparison adjustment.
